notes.title: tanxy 1.0.3 is ready
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW:

 Updated graphics.


BREAKING CHANGES:
[olist]
 unit.run() method renamed to unit.loop().
 New format of .tanxy battle file is not compatible with .tanxy from 1.0.0, 1.0.1, and 1.0.2.
[/olist]

notes.title: tanxy 1.0.1 is ready
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW
[olist]
 Performance improved.
 A lot of bugs fixed.
 JavaScript API extended.
[/olist]
BEWARE!
Incompatible JavaScript API change: unit.angleTo() method is removed. Please look at the new examples to see how to use the new API.
